verdict.rationale: Inside the product, Kick's own AI categorizes about 97% of synced transactions and learns from user corrections. Low-confidence items are left uncategorized for review, which is an in-product AI action on the user's data but is automation rather than insights. Analysis such as trend summaries and forecasts is documented only through external assistants (Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT) reading Kick data in Google Sheets or over MCP, not inside Kick itself. Missing for 10: native in-product AI insights or trend analysis, in-product AI suggestions beyond categorization, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Kick automatically categorizes your transactions and learns from your changes.
the AI categorizes approximately 97% of them on the first pass - things like meals, software subscriptions, payroll, rent, and revenue.
automated categorization, transfer matching, and other AI actions are logged under the relevant Kick agent
